title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 49
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 49: the words concerning Ammon, Edom, Damascus, Kedar and Hazor, and Elam.

questions.text: The first word in this chapter is about whom?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:1 opens: Of the children of Ammon.

questions.text: Against which city will Yahweh cause an alarm of war to be heard?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap.

answers.text: Bozrah in the land of Edom
Hazor of the kingdoms of the east
Rabbah of the children of Ammon

questions.text: Who will go into captivity with his priests and his princes?
questions.explanation: Heshbon is told to wail and the daughters of Rabbah to cry, for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

questions.text: What does Yahweh ask about Teman in the word concerning Edom?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies asks: Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent?

answers.text: Whether wisdom is no more there
Whether its vineyards still bear fruit

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he has done to Esau?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he has made Esau bare and uncovered his secret places, so that he will not be able to hide himself.

answers.text: Clothed him with honor among the nations
Made him bare and uncovered his secret places
Hidden him in the clefts of the rock
Given him the land of Teman for a possession

questions.text: What has deceived the one who dwells in the clefts of the rock?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says the pride of his heart has deceived him, and though he should make his nest as high as the eagle, Yahweh will bring him down.

questions.text: Edom's overthrow is compared to the overthrow of which cities?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says it will be as in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities, where no man will dwell.

answers.text: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah
Nineveh and Babylon and their villages
Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities
Tyre and Sidon and the isles of the sea

questions.text: In the word concerning Damascus, which places are confounded at the evil news?
questions.explanation: The word of Damascus says that Hamath is confounded, and Arpad, for they have heard evil news and have melted away.

questions.text: Whose palaces will the fire in the wall of Damascus devour?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will break, called the chief of Elam's might?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
